shovel.name: Shovel
shovel.desc: Digs a trench from water to your fields. Use it on a trench again to fill it in.

bucket.name: Bucket
bucket.desc: Scoop water from a pond, river or the sea and pour it into a trench or over your crops.

brush.name: Grooming Brush
brush.desc: Groom your lead Wildling to raise its show score.

wild_berry.name: Wild Berry
wild_berry.desc: A tart berry found on bushes.

winter_root.name: Winter Root
winter_root.desc: A starchy root dug from frozen soil.

crystal_fruit.name: Crystal Fruit
crystal_fruit.desc: A glittering fruit that grows in caves.

mystic_ore.name: Mystic Ore
mystic_ore.desc: Glowing ore from the deepest caves.

silver_ore.name: Silver Ore
silver_ore.desc: Smelt into silver bars. Common in the Stone Halls.

mithril_ore.name: Mithril Ore
mithril_ore.desc: Light, cold ore from below the Sunken Lake.

mystic_bar.name: Mystic Bar
mystic_bar.desc: A shimmering bar of mystic metal.

silver_bar.name: Silver Bar
silver_bar.desc: A bar of silver. Eisenkamm's smith works it into rails and lamps.

mithril_bar.name: Mithril Bar
mithril_bar.desc: A feather-light bar that never rusts.

crystal_bar.name: Crystal Bar
crystal_bar.desc: Mithril fused with glimmer crystal. The finest tools are made from it.

star_shard.name: Star Shard
star_shard.desc: A fragment of a fallen star.

glimmer_crystal.name: Glimmer Crystal
glimmer_crystal.desc: It hums faintly. Found only in the deepest layers.

obsidian.name: Obsidian
obsidian.desc: Volcanic glass from the Magma Depths.

geode.name: Geode
geode.desc: Plain on the outside. The Eisenkamm geologist splits them for a small fee.

ammonite.name: Ammonite
ammonite.desc: A spiral shell turned to stone. The museum would love it.

trilobite.name: Trilobite
trilobite.desc: An ancient sea bug, perfectly preserved.

fern_fossil.name: Fern Fossil
fern_fossil.desc: The print of a fern older than the valley.

amber_drop.name: Amber Drop
amber_drop.desc: Golden resin with a tiny bug inside.

ancient_coin.name: Ancient Coin
ancient_coin.desc: Minted by miners who lived here long before Eisenkamm.

sunken_idol.name: Sunken Idol
sunken_idol.desc: A small stone Wildling, worn smooth by the deep water.

fluff.name: Cloud Fluff
fluff.desc: Fluff shed by Fluffeather and Cloudmoo.

wool.name: Frost Wool
wool.desc: Cool wool from Frostpip and Snowpaca.

truffle.name: Truffle
truffle.desc: A rare delicacy dug up by Truffleboar.

spicy_curry.name: Spicy Curry
spicy_curry.desc: Hot enough to make an Embercub sweat.

farmer_lunch.name: Farmer's Lunch
farmer_lunch.desc: Fuel for a long day in the fields.

starfruit_parfait.name: Starfruit Parfait
starfruit_parfait.desc: A legendary dessert. Wildlings adore it.

trail_mix.name: Trail Mix
trail_mix.desc: Nuts and berries for the road.

hearty_pancakes.name: Hearty Pancakes
hearty_pancakes.desc: A tall stack with honey on top.

basic_treat.name: Basic Treat
basic_treat.desc: Offer to a weakened wild Wildling to befriend it.

sweet_treat.name: Sweet Treat
sweet_treat.desc: A tastier treat. Better befriending odds.

lure_charm.name: Lure Charm
lure_charm.desc: A charm that calls to wild Wildlings.

revive_seed.name: Revive Seed
revive_seed.desc: Revives a fainted Wildling with half HP.

sprinkler.name: Sprinkler
sprinkler.desc: Waters the 4 adjacent tiles every morning.

quality_sprinkler.name: Quality Sprinkler
quality_sprinkler.desc: Waters the 8 surrounding tiles every morning.

scarecrow.name: Scarecrow
scarecrow.desc: Keeps crows away from nearby crops.

furnace.name: Furnace
furnace.desc: Smelts ore into bars. Needs coal.

keg.name: Keg
keg.desc: Turns fruit and veggies into juice.

seed_refiner.name: Seed Refiner
seed_refiner.desc: Refines seeds to the next tier, so the plant gives more harvests.

basic_fertilizer.name: Basic Fertilizer
basic_fertilizer.desc: Improves crop quality. Apply to tilled soil.

speed_gro.name: Speed-Gro
speed_gro.desc: Crops grow 25% faster. Apply to tilled soil.

heirloom_charm.name: Heirloom Charm
heirloom_charm.desc: Keep in your bag to pass a parent's Nature to Den eggs.

starry_charm.name: Starry Charm
starry_charm.desc: Triples the chance of meeting Starry Wildlings.

festival_egg.name: Festival Egg
festival_egg.desc: A painted egg from the Egg Hunt. Hand them in at the Show Ring.

bouquet.name: Bouquet
bouquet.desc: Give to a villager at 8 hearts to start dating.

hollow_pendant.name: Hollow Pendant
hollow_pendant.desc: Give to your partner at 10 hearts to propose.

warden_cap.name: Warden Cap
warden_cap.desc: Proof that you beat all eight Wardens.

star_crown.name: Star Crown
star_crown.desc: Worn by those who completed the Wildling-dex.

wildling_egg.name: Wildling Egg
wildling_egg.desc: Place it in the Hatchery. Something is moving inside!

seed_pouch.name: Seed Pouch
seed_pouch.desc: Small outside, roomy inside. Holds seeds and saplings, which go into it automatically.

treat_tin.name: Treat Tin
treat_tin.desc: Holds treats, charms, salves and food.

tool_belt.name: Tool Belt
tool_belt.desc: Keeps all your tools in a tidy 5x2 grid.

forage_basket.name: Forage Basket
forage_basket.desc: A woven basket for crops, fruit, forage and produce.

egg_carrier.name: Egg Carrier
egg_carrier.desc: A padded carrier that holds four Wildling eggs.

gem_case.name: Gem Case
gem_case.desc: A sturdy case for gems, ore and bars.

storage_crate.name: Storage Crate
storage_crate.desc: A 2x2 crate that holds a 5x5 grid of anything (except other containers).

flower_bed.name: Flower Bed
flower_bed.desc: A bright bed of mixed flowers.

birdbath.name: Birdbath
birdbath.desc: Gale Wildlings love to splash in it.

string_lights.name: String Lights
string_lights.desc: Cozy lights that glow at night.

wildling_statue.name: Wildling Statue
wildling_statue.desc: A statue of a Sproutle. Very dignified.

wishing_well.name: Wishing Well
wishing_well.desc: Toss a coin, make a wish. Adds a little luck every day.

windmill.name: Little Windmill
windmill.desc: A cheerful windmill. Your farm's crown jewel.

fishing_rod.name: Fishing Rod
fishing_rod.desc: Hold the tool button to cast into water, let go to throw. Upgrade it at the Gull Bay angler.

bait.name: Bait
bait.desc: Use it on yourself to put it on the rod. Fish bite sooner.

torch.name: Torch
torch.desc: Place it in a mine to light the dark.

mine_ladder.name: Mine Ladder
mine_ladder.desc: Place it in the Deep Mine to dig a way down to the next layer.

support_beam.name: Support Beam
support_beam.desc: Keeps the ceiling up. Stops cave-ins in big halls nearby.

stone_block.name: Stone Block
stone_block.desc: Place it in a mine as a wall, or drop it into water or lava to fill it.

rail.name: Rail
rail.desc: Lay it in a mine. You move much faster along rails.

minecart.name: Minecart
minecart.desc: Place it in a mine. Hop in to ride back to the layer's lift.

cherry_bomb.name: Cherry Bomb
cherry_bomb.desc: Use it in a mine to blast the rock around a tile.

mega_bomb.name: Mega Bomb
mega_bomb.desc: A much bigger blast. Stand well back.

miners_helmet.name: Miner's Helmet
miners_helmet.desc: Keep it in your pack: its lamp lights up much more of the dark.

drill.name: Drill
drill.desc: Breaks three blocks in a row with one swing. Works with your pickaxe's strength.

wild_bait.name: Wild Bait
wild_bait.desc: Fish bite sooner, and rare fish show up more often.

magic_bait.name: Magic Bait
magic_bait.desc: Any fish of this water can bite, whatever the season, time or weather.

spinner.name: Spinner
spinner.desc: Tackle (Gold rod or better). Fish bite sooner. Lasts 20 catches.

cork_bobber.name: Cork Bobber
cork_bobber.desc: Tackle (Gold rod or better). Makes the catch zone bigger. Lasts 20 catches.

trap_bobber.name: Trap Bobber
trap_bobber.desc: Tackle (Gold rod or better). A fish slips away more slowly. Lasts 20 catches.

treasure_lure.name: Treasure Lure
treasure_lure.desc: Tackle (Gold rod or better). Treasure shows up far more often. Lasts 20 catches.

crab_pot.name: Crab Pot
crab_pot.desc: Set it in your farm's water. Catches shellfish on its own every few hours, faster with bait.

smoker.name: Fish Smoker
smoker.desc: Smokes a fish into a tasty snack worth twice as much.

driftwood.name: Driftwood
driftwood.desc: Smoothed by the waves. Burns well.

old_boot.name: Old Boot
old_boot.desc: Someone lost this a long time ago.

soggy_newspaper.name: Soggy Newspaper
soggy_newspaper.desc: The headline is unreadable. Probably about fish.

pearl.name: Pearl
pearl.desc: A perfect pearl from a fishing treasure chest.

fish_stew.name: Fish Stew
fish_stew.desc: A warm bowl that tastes like the river.

maki_roll.name: Maki Roll
maki_roll.desc: Fish and seaweed, rolled up neatly.

salmon_dinner.name: Salmon Dinner
salmon_dinner.desc: Salmon with a side of kale. Fancy.
